name: Santa Teresa Square
summary: Santa Teresa Square is a neighborhood shopping center in San Jose's Santa Teresa district, offering convenient retail and services to the local community. Managed by La Jolla Management Company, the center provides accessible shopping options for southern San Jose residents.
demographics: Santa Teresa Square serves the southern San Jose community, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area includes a diverse demographic mix typical of Silicon Valley, with households earning between $80,000-$150,000 annually and a strong representation of tech industry workers and young families. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday services and neighborhood retail options close to home.
description: Santa Teresa Square is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located at 6005 Snell Avenue in the heart of San Jose's Santa Teresa district. Managed by La Jolla Management Company, this community-focused retail destination has been serving the southern San Jose area with convenient access to essential services and local businesses. The center maintains strong community ties and offers a practical mix of retail and service tenants that cater to the daily needs of nearby residents. With its accessible location and neighborhood-oriented approach, Santa Teresa Square provides a comfortable shopping environment for families and professionals in the growing Santa Teresa community. The property is professionally managed with leasing opportunities available for businesses looking to establish a presence in this thriving South Bay location.
